description: Searches across all data center projects, campuses, phases, and queue filings using free text, natural-language sentences, typo-tolerant fuzzy matching, structured filters, or geographic proximity. Returns ranked matches with canonical IDs, state/ISO counts, and fallback suggestions when zero results match.

canonical_project_id.description: Exact or partial canonical project ID (e.g. 'AXP-US-TX-00040').

company.description: Company, developer, hyperscaler, or utility name, ticker, or organization ID (e.g. 'Microsoft', 'MSFT', 'QTS Data Centers', 'Dominion Energy').

corridor.description: Data center or transmission corridor name (e.g. 'Northern Virginia', 'Central Ohio').

county.description: County or parish name (e.g. 'Loudoun County', 'Richland Parish', 'Dallas').

developer.description: Developer, sponsor, or operator name or abbreviation (e.g. 'Microsoft', 'MSFT', 'QTS', 'Vantage').

energization_year_max.description: Maximum target or actual energization year (e.g. 2029).

energization_year_min.description: Minimum target or actual energization year (e.g. 2026).

has_8760.description: Filter to projects with 8,760-hour hourly load profile intelligence.

has_capital_data.description: Filter to projects with disclosed or verified capital commitments.

has_local_records.description: Filter to projects eligible for local assessor parcel and land contract records.

include_sources.description: Whether to include verified source citation records on each returned project.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 for proximity search (e.g. 32.7767).

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (default: 20, max: 100).

location.description: Place name, city, or county to geocode for spatial search (e.g. 'near Phoenix', 'Dallas, TX').

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 for proximity search (e.g. -96.7970).

max_capital_usd.description: Maximum disclosed or identified capital in USD.

max_mw.description: Alias for mw_max (maximum capacity in MW, e.g. 1000).

min_capital_coverage_ratio.description: Minimum capital coverage ratio against benchmark development cost (e.g. 0.5).

min_capital_usd.description: Minimum disclosed or identified capital in USD (e.g. 1000000000).

min_mw.description: Alias for mw_min (minimum capacity in MW, e.g. 300).

mw_max.description: Maximum project capacity in megawatts across IT or facility MW (e.g. 1000).

mw_min.description: Minimum project capacity in megawatts across IT or facility MW (e.g. 300).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Exact or partial Map project ID (e.g. 'P017', 'CVP0003').

query.description: Free-text query or natural sentence matching project names, aliases, developers, owners, tenants, utilities, cities, counties, states, ISOs, queue IDs, and canonical IDs (e.g. 'Microsoft projects over 300 MW in Texas', 'Dallas, TX', 'Stargate Abilene', 'NoVA').
examples: Microsoft projects over 300 MW in Texas

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around location or coordinates (default: 25).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

sort.description: Sort order for search results: 'relevance', 'mw', 'energization_date', 'distance', or 'recently_updated'.

state.description: US state code or full state name (e.g. 'TX', 'Texas', 'VA', 'Virginia', 'OH').

tenant.description: Anchor tenant or hyperscaler offtaker filter (e.g. 'OpenAI', 'Microsoft', 'Oracle').

utility.description: Serving electric utility, wholesale provider, or retail distributor (e.g. 'Oncor', 'AEP Ohio', 'Dominion').

name: search_projects

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Search Projects
